summary: Fixed bug #57 by making overlaps() in booking/ranges.py use strict comparisons (a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end), so back-to-back half-open intervals such as 9:00-10:00 and 10:00-11:00 no longer conflict. All 3 tests in tests/test_ranges.py pass.
assumptions: Intervals are half-open [start, end) as documented in booking/interval.py, so touching endpoints do not count as overlap.

Fixed only overlaps() as the bug report asked. intersects() in booking/interval.py still uses <= and is left unchanged because merge_ranges() depends on it; merge_ranges still coalesces touching ranges through its adjacent() check.
Zero-length intervals (start == end) are treated as sharing no time with any interval under the strict comparison.
